scope: Root read-only audit of an unwired four-call protocol prototype; target outcomes do not assess every other recipient or establish quality

residual_findings.reason: Prototype still assigns individual look/hear from collective observation and reports, marks whole and safe; individual sensory distribution remains unproven. Do not treat all target matches as complete batch acceptance.

recommended_next_step: Version a separate per-recipient knowledge/evidence review and preserve all vetoes; diagnose individual sensory allocation and new native builds before using a fixture for chat. No default promotion based on these four cases.
